The United States’ GDP per capita in 1850 was about $3,000 in 2011 PPP dollars. Maddison’s figure is roughly $1,800 in 1990 international dollars, which scales to that 2011 level with the US price rise from 1990 to 2011, and nominal income near $110 lines up with the same result. The matching choice is B.

CONFIDENCE: 86
